description: Scenario tests for carousel-builder. A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied.

evals.name: copy-to-files-happy-path
evals.input: Here's my 7-slide carousel copy about pricing mistakes. Make the slides, I want PNGs I can post.
expect: looks for or creates a brand kit before rendering
maps each beat to a slide type in carousel.json (cover, text/list, recap, cta)
runs scripts/build-carousel.cjs and reports the output files
reads the QA result and does not hand over a build with errors
looks at the contact sheet before presenting
hands the caption to caption-writer and scheduling to scheduling-and-queue without publishing

evals.name: idea-only-routes-to-writer
evals.input: Make me a professional carousel about time management.
expect: writes or routes the copy through carousel-writer (cover via hook-writer) before designing
does not design around missing copy
then renders with the build script

evals.name: azerbaijani-glyph-coverage
evals.input: Karuseli Bebas Neue şrifti ilə hazırla, mətn Azərbaycan dilindədir.
expect: sets language to az in the brand kit
reports the missing-glyph error for ə (or checks coverage first)
proposes a font that covers Azerbaijani instead of shipping fallback glyphs
replies in Azerbaijani

evals.name: overflow-means-cut-words
evals.input: The build says slide 4 overflows. Just make the font smaller.
expect: explains the build already auto-shrinks and the error means too many words
cuts or splits the slide rather than lowering type size or margins
rebuilds until exit code is 0

evals.name: unsourced-stat
evals.input: Put '87% of buyers check Instagram before buying' on a stat slide.
expect: asks for or requires a real source for the number
does not invent a source
offers to drop or rephrase the slide if no source exists

evals.name: pick-a-theme
evals.input: Which style should I use? I can't decide.
expect: renders --theme all and shows themes.png
recommends a theme based on the content type, not taste
advises keeping one theme for the series

evals.name: multi-client-brand-kits
evals.input: I manage 4 clients. I want each one's carousels to always look on-brand.
expect: sets up one brand kit JSON per client (colours, fonts, logo, handle, language)
shows using --brand to render the same spec for another client
keeps one accent colour per kit

evals.name: linkedin-pdf
expect: points to carousel.pdf as a LinkedIn document post
routes the post text to linkedin-post-writer
does not claim to publish it
